Bill.BriefDescription: Establishing an approval process for prekindergarten programs.

BillBody.BillTitle: AN ACT Relating to prekindergarten; and adding new sections tochapter 28A.215 RCW.
BillBody.EnactingClause: BE IT ENACTED BY THE LEGISLATURE OF THE STATE OF WASHINGTON:

BillSection.RCWSLText: The legislature intends to establish acertification process for public and nonpublic prekindergarten programsto seek voluntary approval, by the state board of education, of theirchild development and educational offerings. The purpose of theapproval is to give parents and other consumers of prekindergartenprograms some standard to use to assess the quality of prekindergartenprograms and the program's ability to prepare children forkindergarten.

By rule, the state board of education shalladopt standards and procedures for the certification and approval ofall public and nonpublic prekindergarten programs. The standards forapproval shall require that the programs provide the children with theacademic skills that are needed for the children to be successful asthey enter into the next level of school. Such programs are encouragedto apply for approval. In developing standards, the state board of p. 1 SB 5548education shall review nationally developed standards. However, beforeany standards or procedures for approval of prekindergarten programsare implemented, the state board of education shall present thestandards and procedures to the education committees of the house ofrepresentatives and the senate for the committees' review and comment.
The state board of education shall post alist of approved prekindergarten programs on the board's internet website.
Sections 1 through 3 of this act are eachadded to chapter 28A.215 RCW.
